item.title: Montgomery County Encourages Public to Vote for the 250th Street Bridge in the “Bridge as a Fashion Model” Competition - KCSI 95.3 FM | KOAK 1080 AM
item.description: Montgomery County officials are calling on residents, partners, and supporters to cast their vote for the county’s own 250th Street Bridge, which has been officially entered into the 2026 “Bridge as a Fashion Model” competition. The county’s submission features a striking scenic image that captures the structure’s beauty in progress and the landscape it serves.

item.title: County Director Sadie Lindgren says 4-H numbers are trending upward this year - KCSI 95.3 FM | KOAK 1080 AM
